summary: Implement Proxy [[DefineOwnProperty]] via defineProperty trap, boolean coercion, and descriptor/extensibility invariants.

target.notes: Validate revocation, perform GetMethod trap lookup, call the trap with handler as this, then enforce the ECMAScript Proxy invariant before returning.

semantics.invariants: truthy result cannot add to non-extensible target, invent new non-configurable property, or claim descriptor changes incompatible with protected target descriptor

caveats: If the trap is absent/undefined, forward to the corresponding target internal method.
Trap property lookup itself can invoke a getter and throw.
A C# interceptor that trusts the trap result without target invariant checks is not semantics-preserving.

tests.name: cannot claim add on non-extensible target
tests.input: const t={};Object.preventExtensions(t);const p=new Proxy(t,{defineProperty(){return true}});try{Reflect.defineProperty(p,'x',{value:1})}catch(e){console.log(e instanceof TypeError)}
